:::{#exm-set}
#### Sets of die rolls

The possible results of rolling a six-sided die form the set $\set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$,
with $3 \in \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$ and $7 \notin \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$.
The sets $\set{1, 2, 3}$ and $\set{3, 2, 1}$ are equal,
because they have the same elements;
the order in which the elements are listed does not matter.

:::
